About HappyRobot
HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.
Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.
This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.
Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.
This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.

Tech Profile
• 
Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.
• 
Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.
• 
Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.
• 
Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
experiment and iterate.
• 
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
cause of issues.

Must Have
• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
• 
Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
tight deadlines.
• 
Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
propose solutions.
• 
Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
action.
• 
Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?
• 
Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
• 
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
• 
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
• 
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
• 
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.
 
Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.
 
Craftsmanship
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.
 
We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.
 
Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.
 
Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.
 
First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

Location and Working Hours

This role is based in the APJ region and requires substantial daily overlap with APJ business hours. The Territory Operations team works asynchronously across regions, so comfort with written handoffs and documentation is more important than real-time availability outside your local hours.

About the Role

This is an early-career role designed for someone with foundational operations, analytics, or CRM experience who wants to build depth in sales systems and territory management. You will learn our territory carving and account routing processes from the ground up, with structured onboarding, a defined ramp plan, and close support from the broader Territory Operations team. Prior territory operations experience is not required — curiosity, care with data, and clear communication matter more.

Responsibilities

  • Support cross-functional annual planning activities related to territory carving and deployment in Salesforce for the APJ region, with guidance from senior team members
  • Help maintain and document territory operations processes, including runbooks and onboarding materials for APJ stakeholders
  • Respond to account routing questions from the APJ field, escalating complex or ambiguous cases to senior analysts
  • Support recurring territory reporting and ad hoc analysis requests for APJ sales leadership
  • Partner with APJ Field Sales, Sales Operations, and Revenue Strategy to understand regional coverage needs and surface opportunities to improve territory processes and tools
  • Assist the Sales Systems team on automation improvements enabled by territory management (such as automated opportunity assignment)
  • Support data hygiene and enrichment for APJ accounts using tools such as RingLead, ZoomInfo, D&B, and Openprise, including validating account data across multiple APJ countries and markets
  • Document questions, edge cases, and process gaps encountered in day-to-day work so they can be addressed systematically

Requirements

  • 1–2 years of experience in an operations, analytics, business support, or CRM-adjacent role — sales operations experience is welcome but not required
  • Based in the APJ region, or able to maintain consistent overlap with APJ business hours
  • Working familiarity with Salesforce (navigating records, reports, and list views); exposure to Salesforce Sales Territories, Salesforce Maps, or similar tools is a plus
  • Comfortable working in spreadsheets — sorting, filtering, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and pivot tables; advanced modeling is not expected
  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to working with data
  • Clear and concise written communication, particularly in asynchronous settings across time zones
  • Collaborative and comfortable asking questions; you will be supported, not left to figure things out alone
  • Interest in learning sales operations systems and processes in a fast-paced, distributed environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting stakeholders across multiple APJ countries or working with multilingual account data
  • Exposure to data enrichment or data quality tools (RingLead, ZoomInfo, D&B, Openprise, or similar)
  • Familiarity with SQL, Tableau, or other reporting tools
  • Salesforce Administrator certification or coursework in progress

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Headquarters: Remote

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

As the Director of Product Marketing at Storyblok, We're looking for a Product Marketing Director to shape how we position, launch, and grow our product in the market- particularly in the US, UK and EMEA. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can translate complex technical capability into compelling, credible narratives — and who's comfortable in the room with engineers as much as with executives. You'll own the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing at a stage where positioning decisions have outsized impact on growth.

You will guide a talented team, focusing on sales enablement, website conversion, feature adoption, and Storyblok’s market positioning with industry analysts and customer review platforms. A key responsibility is to elevate our product marketing function to influence revenue, customer acquisition, and market leadership.

Your mission is to enable Storyblok to win in the market by clearly articulating our value, differentiation, and future direction.

What you’ll bring:

You're genuinely comfortable operating in technical territory, not just translating it secondhand. You can read API documentation, understand headless CMS architecture, and hold a credible, detailed conversation with engineers and technical evaluators about how the product actually works — its components, integration points, and trade-offs versus alternative approaches. This fluency shows up in the quality of your messaging: you write positioning that developers trust because it's accurate, not just persuasive. 

You've likely worked hands-on with developers before, whether as a technical product marketer, solutions engineer, technical product manager, or in an engineering-adjacent role, and you know how to earn credibility with a technical audience rather than assume it.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Product Positioning & Messaging

• Own and evolve our core messaging and differentiated value proposition across all audiences (developers, marketers, partners, enterprise buyers), setting the strategic framework the wider team executes against

• Direct ongoing customer, market, and competitive research programs to ensure messaging stays relevant, differentiated, and current

• Set the standard for translating product capabilities and roadmap into solution-oriented, benefits-led messaging that resonates across the buyer journey

• Ensure messaging consistency and governance across all channels — website, campaigns, sales assets, analyst briefings, and customer communications

Go-To-Market Strategy & Execution

• Own GTM strategy for major product and feature launches, driving alignment across Product, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, and Content leadership

• Define phased rollout strategies that drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact across key customer segments

• Set the standard for launch toolkits — messaging frameworks, FAQs, competitive positioning, product one-pagers, internal training — and build the team capability to produce them at scale

• Establish the measurement framework for launch performance and adoption, using it to continuously improve release execution

Sales Enablement & Sales Plays

• Build a structured sales playbook program aligned to product capabilities, customer pain points, and vertical use cases.

• Equip revenue teams with high-impact content (battlecards, ROI calculators, solution briefs, demo scripts, objection handling).

• Partner directly with Sales Leadership on rep onboarding, conversion effectiveness, and keeping messaging aligned to evolving sales motions

• Use sales performance data, win/loss interviews, and customer feedback to identify and prioritize enablement investments

Analyst & Review Site Strategy

• Define and lead the analyst relations strategy to secure meaningful participation in key analyst evaluations (e.g., Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape).

• Orchestrate analyst briefing cycles, submission processes, and relationships that enhance Storyblok’s visibility and influence.

• Own our presence and growth strategy on review platforms (G2, Gartner Peer Insights), including review acquisition and profile optimization

• Establish ongoing monitoring and response mechanisms for public reviews and rankings

Website & CRO Performance

• Partner with Growth Marketing and Web leadership to ensure product positioning is clearly and consistently represented site-wide

• Set priorities for CRO initiatives that improve engagement, conversion, and self-serve funnel performance

• Define messaging strategy and success metrics for key product pages, feature highlights, and trial flows

• Direct ongoing testing and optimization of messaging, CTAs, layouts, and journey flows based on data

Lead, mentor, and inspire the Product Marketing team to deliver high-impact outcomes aligned with company goals.

• Set team structure, priorities, and ways of working in partnership with marketing leadership

• Coach the team on messaging craft, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration

• Foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning.

• Develop individual growth plans, conduct regular performance reviews, and ensure team members have access to relevant coaching and training opportunities.

• Ensure strong collaboration across Product, Growth, Brand, and Sales teams to drive alignment and accountability.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• 8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, with at least 2+ years in a leadership role.

• Proven experience in a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment.

• Strong understanding of PLG motions, SaaS business models, and the product lifecycle.

• Demonstrated success in GTM execution, analyst engagement, and pricing strategy.

• Exceptional communication skills and executive presence.

• Skilled in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder influence.

• Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Marketing Automation, G2, and PMM platforms (e.g., Klue) a plus.

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

U.S. Base Salary Range: $184,200 - $250,000

At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. While supporting the transition from the legacy Cloudera Hadoop platform to Databricks on AWS, this role will continue to play a key part in enhancing performance, simplifying pipelines, and delivering new capabilities on the Databricks platform over the long term.

The ideal candidate is a strong hands‑on Spark engineer with solid design experience, capable of contributing to architectural decisions while leading complex implementation and optimization efforts.

Responsibilities:

• Platform Engineering & Modernization
• Refactor and modernize existing Spark pipelines to Databricks native architectures
• Eliminate legacy Hadoop dependencies and adopt cloud native AWS patterns
• Enhance and extend existing processing logic using optimized Spark (JavaSpark / PySpark) on Databricks
• Databricks Native Development
• Build and optimize solutions using Databricks features, including Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows for orchestration and Auto scaling and job clusters
• Design & Solution Engineering
• Contribute to low and mid level architecture and design
• Translate high level architecture into detailed technical designs
• Define data models, pipeline patterns, and reusable components
• Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and production ready
• Performance Optimization & Simplification
• Analyze, improve Spark job performance and simplify complex or over engineered pipelines into standardized, efficient patterns
• Engineering Standards & Best Practices
• Follow and contribute to Databricks and Spark engineering standards
• Write clean, modular, and testable code
• Contribute to shared frameworks, reusable libraries, and quality standards
• Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
• Work closely with senior architects, platform teams, and DevOps engineers
• Provide technical inputs, troubleshooting support, and implementation guidance
• Participate in design discussions and technical decision making
• Testing & Quality Assurance
• Develop unit, integration, and data validation tests
• Support production releases and post deployment validation

Qualifications:

Core Technical Skills

• 11+ years in data engineering or distributed systems
• Strong expertise in Apache Spark (JavaSpark / PySpark), Databricks on AWS, and Delta Lake
• Experience on SQL
• Experience with AWS services and large‑scale distributed data processing

Modernization & Optimization Experience

• Experience modernizing or refactoring legacy data platforms into cloud‑based architectures
• Strong background in Spark performance tuning and large‑scale batch optimization

Design Capability

• Ability to translate architecture into implementable designs
• Understanding of data modeling and pipeline orchestration patterns

Behavioral Competencies

• Strong problem‑solving mindset for complex distributed systems
• Comfortable working in time‑bound, high‑impact environments
• Proactive, accountable, and collaborative
• Clear communication skills across global teams

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in B2B sales, strong leadership skills, and a passion for driving business success. **Responsibilities:** 1) Business Development: Identify and target new business opportunities through research, networking, and outreach efforts. Develop and execute sales strategies to acquire new clients and achieve revenue targets. b99bebd80e9b1445.description: About Reputation Reputation, founded in Silicon Valley in 2013, is the industry's sole platform that uses an AI-powered product stack to help companies measure, manage, and scale their real-time reputation performance everywhere, effectively functioning as a business's eyes and ears across all customer feedback channels to uncover predictive insights. This market leadership is reinforced by significant funding from top-tier firms like Bessemer Venture Partner, Kleiner Perkins, and Marlin Equity Partners, driving substantial annual recurring revenue from Global Fortune 1000 companies, major automotive OEMs, healthcare systems, and top property management firms, with trust from over 250 partners including Google and Meta. Recognized recently as Americas Greatest Midsized Workplaces by Newsweek which rewards excellence and career development, and attracts player-coaches, team-oriented collaborators, and individuals who value perseverance and hustle. Job Summary : Reputation is seeking a Go Backend Engineer with PERN Stack experience to maintain and contribute to a large ecosystem of production microservices and web services running on GCP. In this role, you will keep services healthy, resolve issues, and deliver new features across a well-established distributed platform. While Go is the primary language, the platform also includes a PERN stack (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js), and you will be expected to work comfortably across both. We are looking for engineers who can build simple, fast, and scalable software in a fast-paced environment. Responsibilities: Maintain and enhance existing Go microservices across a distributed, event-driven platform. Contribute to Node.js/Express and GraphQL API services as needed. Support and maintain React (Class Components) frontend applications when required. Contribute to new feature development based on product and business requirements. Manage and update Helm charts for deployments across Stage, Production, and EU environments. Maintain and improve GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents across services. Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests (using Testify and testcontainers-go). Participate in code reviews and uphold code quality standards. Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams on infrastructure-related changes. Additional duties as assigned. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 2+ years of hands-on Go (Golang) development experience in a production environment, with exposure to Node.js/Express and React. Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems patterns, and experience working in a large microservices ecosystem (50+ services). Proficiency with Kubernetes and Helm writing and managing Helm charts for multi-environment deployments. Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows including build, test, and deploy pipelines. Experience with GCP services, particularly Pub/Sub for event-driven messaging, and RabbitMQ (AMQP) for message queue management. Solid experience with PostgreSQL (including ORM usage via GORM/pgx) and Redis. Familiarity with Elasticsearch (indexing, querying, and percolation patterns). Experience with Docker and containerized application development. Familiarity with structured logging, health checks, Prometheus metrics instrumentation, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry). Experience with Node.js, Express.js, and GraphQL (schema design, resolvers, API integration). Familiarity with React (specifically Class Components) for maintaining existing frontend applications. Exposure to AWS Redshift or data warehouse integrations, multi-region cloud deployments (US + EU on GCP), and Terraform for infrastructure-as-code. Strong problem-solving skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and ability to work independently in a distributed team. Our Benefits & Perks We believe our people deserve to feel supported, valued, and rewarded both in and out of work. Thats why we offer a generous and thoughtfully designed benefits package, including: Health Insurance & Wellness Benefits: Group Health Insurance: Medical Insurance with floater policy of up to Rs 10,00,000 for employee + spouse + 2 dependent children + 2 parents / parent-in-laws Maternity Benefits: Medical insurance up to 75,000 INR, 26 weeks of leave for birth, adoption or surrogacy Life Insurance: Insurance at 3x annual cost to the company (Term Insurance, GPA) Accident/Disability Insurance: Insured at 3x base salary for permanent total disability, permanent partial disability and temporary total disability (GPA) OPD: As part of your health benefits, Employees are entitled to an annual OPD allowance of 7,500. This can be used for doctor consultations, diagnostic tests, and prescribed medications. The benefit is applicable to both the employee and eligible

b9ee744c90167dcd.description:
Headquarters: Remote
 
URL: https://ondeckglobal.com/

About the Role

We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer with a strong understanding of the iGaming industry to create engaging, intuitive, and visually compelling digital experiences.
You will be responsible for designing user-focused interfaces across online casino, sportsbook, betting, and gaming platforms, working closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to transform product requirements into seamless player experiences.
The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with UX thinking and understands how to design interfaces that are engaging, responsive, conversion-focused, and easy to navigate.

Key Responsibilities

• Design modern, high-quality UI/UX for iGaming websites, web apps, and mobile experiences.

• Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces in Figma.

• Design key iGaming experiences such as casino lobbies, sportsbook interfaces, game discovery, promotions, tournaments, loyalty/VIP areas, registration, deposits, and withdrawals.

• Improve player journeys with a focus on usability, engagement, retention, and conversion.

• Build and maintain scalable design systems, UI components, typography, iconography, and reusable design patterns.

• Create responsive designs that deliver a consistent experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Development, Marketing, CRM, and other teams from concept through implementation.

• Work with developers to ensure accurate implementation and maintain high visual quality.

• Use research, analytics, user feedback, and product insights to identify UX improvements.

• Continuously improve existing interfaces through iteration, testing, and optimization.

• Stay current with iGaming design trends, competitor products, UX best practices, and emerging technologies.

• Design with accessibility, responsible gaming principles, and market-specific requirements in mind.

Required Skills & Experience

• 7+ years of UI/UX or Product Design experience, preferably within iGaming, gaming, fintech, entertainment, or another fast-paced digital product environment.

• Strong portfolio demonstrating polished UI design and thoughtful UX problem-solving.

• Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, Auto Layout, prototyping, and design systems.

• Strong understanding of responsive and mobile-first design.

• Excellent knowledge of typography, spacing, grids, color, hierarchy, and interaction design.

• Experience translating complex product requirements into simple, intuitive user experiences.

• Good understanding of user journeys, conversion funnels, and usability principles.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with developers and understand technical constraints.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain consistency across large products.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

iGaming Experience — Strong Advantage

Experience designing any of the following will be highly valued:

• Online Casino & Live Casino

• Sportsbook & Sports Betting

• Slots and Game Lobbies

• Registration & KYC flows

• Deposits, Withdrawals & Payment UX

• Bonuses & Promotions

• VIP & Loyalty Programs

• Tournaments & Gamification

• Player Account & Wallet Experiences

• CRM and Retention Experiences

• Multi-brand or White-label Gaming Platforms

Nice to Have

• Experience with A/B testing and conversion optimization.

• Understanding of HTML/CSS and front-end development principles.

• Experience working with analytics and behavioral tools.

• Experience designing gamification and reward mechanics.

• Motion design or micro-interaction experience.

• Experience working with international or multi-market products.

• Familiarity with accessibility standards and responsible gaming UX.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for more than someone who can make screens look good.
You should be able to understand player behavior, business objectives, and product requirements, then turn them into experiences that are intuitive, engaging, and commercially effective.
You care about the details, challenge weak UX, communicate your design decisions clearly, and enjoy building digital products that players genuinely enjoy using.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ondeckglobal-igaming-ui-ux-designer
